info.title: Facebook Clone API
info.description:
REST API for the Facebook clone: accounts, posts, reels, reactions, comments and friends.

**Signing in:** call `POST /auth/register` or `POST /auth/login`, copy the `token` from the response, then press **Authorize** above and paste it. Every route except register and login needs it.

**Reels are posts.** A reel is a post with `type: "reel"` and exactly one video, so posts and reels share the same endpoints, including comments and reactions.

**Rate limits:** `/api/auth/*` allows 20 requests per 15 minutes per IP; everything else allows 500.

errors.description: Present on validation failures: one message per field.

example.email: Please provide a valid email address.

token.description: JWT, valid for JWT_EXPIRES_IN (7d by default).

Person.description: A trimmed user, used by friend lists and suggestions.

Reactions.description: Tally of a post's reactions plus the reaction of the caller.

counts.description: How many people picked each reaction type.

viewerReaction.description: The caller's own reaction, or null.

title.example: Small moments from a slow morning.

groupId.description: Set when the post belongs to a group; null for the main feed.

FriendEdge.description: One friendship row, seen from the caller's side.

id.description: Friendship id — use this to accept or remove.

FriendLists.description: Your friendships split by what the UI does with each one.

incoming.description: Pending requests other people sent you.

viewerRole.description: The caller's role, or null when they are not a member.

Forbidden.description: Signed in, but not allowed to touch this resource.

example.message: You can only edit your own posts.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests. /api/auth/* allows 20 per 15 minutes, everything else 500.

example.message: Too many requests from this IP, please try again after 15 minutes.

post.description: Creates the account and signs you in straight away. Phone is stored as a string, so a leading zero is kept.

example.message: This account has been deactivated. Contact support to restore it.

patch.description: Every field is optional — send only what changes. `work` must be 5-100 characters, so it cannot be cleared to an empty string.

delete.description: A soft delete: the row stays in the database with status "inactive". Login and every existing token stop working immediately. Posts are kept.

400.description: The id is not a valid ObjectId.

404.description: No such user, or the account is deactivated.

get.description: Newest first. A reel is a post with type "reel", so the same endpoint serves both feeds.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Only this author. Used by the profile page.

parameters.name: groupId
parameters.description: A group's feed. Omit it for the main feed, which excludes group posts. A private group is members-only.

post.description: Upload media first with POST /upload, then send the URLs it returns. A reel needs exactly one video; a post needs text or at least one file.

groupId.description: Posts into a group. You have to be a member of it.

patch.summary: Edit your own post or reel
patch.description: Text only — media cannot be swapped after publishing. An edit that would leave the post with no text and no media is rejected.

delete.summary: Delete your own post or reel

put.description: One reaction per person per post, so calling this again replaces the previous one rather than adding another. likeCount mirrors how many people reacted.

type.description: The client maps names to numbers: 1 like, 2 love, 3 care, 4 haha, 5 wow, 6 sad, 7 angry.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A post id for GET and POST, a comment id for DELETE.

get.summary: List the comments on a post or reel
get.description: `id` is the **post** id. Oldest first. A post with no comments returns an empty array, not a 404.

post.description: `id` is the **post** id. Also bumps the post's commentCount.

delete.description: `id` is the **comment** id. Only the author may delete, and the post's commentCount goes back down.

get.description: Searches both directions, so requests you received show up under `incoming` and ones you sent under `outgoing`.
Active accounts you are not already connected to in either direction, newest first.

post.description: Refused if you target yourself, if the account does not exist, or if a request already exists in either direction.

409.description: A request already exists between you two.

put.description: Only the person who received the request may answer it. Accepting raises both people's friendsCount, and only on a real change, so calling it twice does not double-count.

403.description: Only the recipient can answer a request.

example.message: Only the person who received this request can answer it.

delete.summary: Unfriend, decline a request, or cancel one you sent
delete.description: All three are the same operation: the row is removed. Only the two people involved may do it, and friendsCount only drops if the request had been accepted.

403.description: You are not part of this friendship.

example.message: You are not part of this friendship.

get.summary: Discover groups, or list your own
get.description: By default returns public groups you have **not** joined, busiest first. Pass `mine=true` for the groups you belong to, including private ones.

parameters.name: mine
parameters.description: true returns your groups instead of suggestions.

post.description: You become its first member, with the admin role.

get.description: A private group returns 404 unless you are a member, so its existence is not leaked.

403.description: You are not an admin of this group.

example.message: Only a group admin can do that.

delete.description: Admins only. Removes the group, every membership and every post in it.

403.description: You are not an admin of this group.

example.message: Only a group admin can do that.

get.description: Admins first. A private group is members-only.

post.description: Public groups only — a private group returns 403.

example.message: You are already in this group.

delete.description: The only remaining admin cannot leave — promote someone else or delete the group.

example.message: You are the only admin. Make someone else an admin, or delete the group.

delete.description: Admins only. The creator cannot be removed, and you cannot remove yourself.

403.description: Not an admin, or the target is the creator.

example.message: The group creator cannot be removed.

post.summary: Send images and videos to Cloudinary
post.description: Multipart form data under the field name `media`, up to 6 files at once. Images must be under 10MB, videos under 100MB. Nothing is written to the server disk — the files are streamed straight through. Use the URLs it returns when creating a post, a reel, an avatar or a cover photo.

400.description: Wrong file type, too many files, or a file over the size cap.

example.message: clip.txt is not an image or video.

errors.media: Only image and video files can be uploaded.
